measured_replay.note: Common fitted measurements within each viewpoint. Scoring phase from prescribed scenario only; never used by filters. Absolute center bias and future displacement error kept separate.

limitations: No adaptive online model selection or IMM; established Singer model only.
No published safety theorem or physical/multi-robot validation of these candidates.
Gazebo random seed was not pinned; callback timing and wall-budget NLP are not deterministic. Single trials do not isolate causal effects or establish statistical superiority.
Three 32-second experiments failed the endpoint tracking criterion despite positive sampled body clearance; these are retained.
The 64-second diagnostic is an independent rerun that had already settled near 29s. It cannot prove extending the failed 32s trial would recover.
Shifted-frame norm projection is a necessary velocity-coordinate condition in a soft field, not the full nonholonomic feasible set or an assurance of convergence. Default remains off.
0.95 covariance multiplier is not a calibrated 95% probability; zero-speed fallback is not proved safe against moving obstacles.
